description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers hi-fi options/alternatives requests. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: wireframe (lo-fi structure exploration), design-intelligence (single grounded direction), design-review (review existing), image generation, and single-implementation feature work.

queries.q: show me 3 different takes on this pricing page
give me a few design options for the dashboard header
I can't decide on the hero layout — build some alternatives I can compare
make this settings screen in a safe version and a bold version
let me play with color and density options on this card grid
sketch a few rough layout directions for the signup flow before we style anything
pick a visual direction and palette for our new SaaS app
review this landing page design for issues

queries.note: single implementation, no options ask → fe-design / stack executor
